versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei抖音全面数据挖掘器 (guaikei-douyin-thorough-data-miner)
- Supports keyword search, creator post fetching, video comment retrieval, and real-time hot ranking for Douyin.
- Structured JSON output for use cases like content research, competitor analysis, sentiment exploration, and trend tracking.
- Flexible intent recognition and command triggering, including generalized triggers for short video research tasks.
- Token authorization and error handling strictly conforming to outlined security and compliance standards.
- Comprehensive command options with parameter inference and clear input/output conventions.
